_comment: Cards that exist only for the put-into-graveyard trigger test (tests/unit/triggers/test_put_into_graveyard.py). Never part of a deck list. `t_land_drinker` is The Gitrog Monster's draw, batched; `t_greedy_land_drinker` the same trigger WITHOUT `batched`, the counterfactual. `t_grave_pinger` is Syr Konrad's middle clause; `t_grave_reaver` Colossal Grave-Reaver's batch-bound reanimation; `t_grave_returner` a Centaur Vinecrasher shape that listens from its own graveyard.

cards.name: Test Land Drinker
cards.oracle_text: Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere, draw a card.

abilities.text: Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere, draw a card.

cards.name: Test Greedy Land Drinker
cards.oracle_text: Whenever a land card is put into your graveyard from anywhere, draw a card.

abilities.text: Whenever a land card is put into your graveyard from anywhere, draw a card.

cards.name: Test Grave Pinger
cards.oracle_text: Whenever a creature card is put into a graveyard from anywhere other than the battlefield, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.

abilities.text: Whenever a creature card is put into a graveyard from anywhere other than the battlefield, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.

cards.name: Test Grave Reaver
cards.oracle_text: Whenever one or more creature cards are put into your graveyard from your library, put one of them onto the battlefield.

abilities.text: Whenever one or more creature cards are put into your graveyard from your library, put one of them onto the battlefield.

cards.name: Test Grave Returner
cards.oracle_text: Whenever a land card is put into a graveyard from anywhere, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.

abilities.text: Whenever a land card is put into a graveyard from anywhere, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
